name: elven silver
lore_descriptor: moon-pale silver, polished by elven hands
first_pickup_chronicle: Elven silver — alloyed by hands that worked while the moon was up. It holds blessings the way other metals hold rust.
design_notes: Band B light-enchantable rare_metal. Mid mult (1.0), light weight (0.8), max_enchant 5. Sets up the 'cool elven gear' niche midgame. Sister to quicksilver/godweave.
